ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) ratio estimated at 65:35 across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions in the center of both lobes; thick black margins at the trailing edge and peduncle junction; dark mottled patches and linear streaks distributed throughout.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped notch with an internal angle of approximately 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly serrated trailing edge with frequent low-amplitude variations and several distinct notches on the right lobe's posterior boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep from the notch to the tips, exhibiting an upward-curving arc.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of circular, high-contrast white/tan features (barnacles) on both lateral tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Significant dark linear rake marks crossing the white field, notably a set of parallel diagonal lines on the left lobe and vertical scratches on the right.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on both fluke tips and significant surface scarring across the ventral lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct small circular black ring-shaped mark located on the white portion of the right lobe.
